name: superagnt
description: superagnt_ — the agent value layer. The base plugin carries the MCP server (data sources, workspace Postgres, schedules, canvases) plus the base skill set; skill plugins add packaged workflows on top.

plugins.name: superagnt
plugins.description: The superagnt MCP server + base skills: external data in one call, a workspace Postgres, recurring automations, shareable canvases. OAuth on first tool call — the consent screen doubles as signup.

plugins.name: warm-outbound-engine
plugins.description: The LinkedIn Engagement Outbound skill: an agent that pulls the people reacting to and commenting on the posts your market engages with, scores them against your ICP before it spends anything on enrichment, and stages what fits into HeyReach, Instantly, AgentMail or your own Gmail. The campaign stays stopped until you start it. Skills-only pack, pulls the superagnt base plugin as a dependency.

plugins.name: audience-radar
plugins.description: The Content Ideas Engine skill: an agent that mines X for what your audience talks about on a schedule and writes cited content-idea reports. Skills-only pack — pulls the superagnt base plugin (MCP server + base skills) as a dependency.

plugins.name: competitor-mindshare
plugins.description: The Competitor Tracker skill: identical daily X measurements per brand, logged to your workspace database with a shareable trend dashboard. Skills-only pack — pulls the superagnt base plugin as a dependency.

plugins.name: gtm-prospecting-desk
plugins.description: The Outbound Pipeline Engine skill: ICP-filtered company and people discovery, verified emails, scored rows and outreach drafts in one compounding pipeline table. Skills-only pack — pulls the superagnt base plugin as a dependency.

plugins.name: super-seo
plugins.description: The Super SEO skill: a full SEO operating system. Search Console as ground truth, every candidate action scored on one scale and worked top-down: page drafts, refreshes, on-page fixes, link pitches, indexing and AI-answer visibility, backed by a bundled practitioner-research corpus. Skills-only pack — pulls the superagnt base plugin as a dependency.

plugins.name: video-multiplier
plugins.description: The Video Multiplier skill: an agent that turns one YouTube upload into the full package — chapters, title options, description, and a week of post drafts built from the transcript. Skills-only pack — pulls the superagnt base plugin as a dependency.

plugins.name: shortform-script-engine
plugins.description: The Short-Form Script Engine skill: an agent that studies the top-performing videos in your niche each week and writes five ready-to-film scripts built on the hooks that keep winning. Skills-only pack — pulls the superagnt base plugin as a dependency.

plugins.name: newsletter-autopilot
plugins.description: The Newsletter Autopilot skill: an agent that researches your topics on X and the web all week and assembles a complete, cited issue draft on send day. Skills-only pack — pulls the superagnt base plugin as a dependency.
